name: flaggems_scaled_int8_quant
description: Extracted from FlagGems-vllm PR #63 scaled_int8_quant. Covers dynamic/static and symmetric/asymmetric INT8 quantization. Both correctness and timing use the portable pure-Torch decomposition rather than vllm._custom_ops; timing results therefore use a different baseline from the source PR. Static scale/azp value semantics are checked, but the current v5 evaluator cannot preserve the source test's output-input object-identity assertions across custom validation.
